policy: Every entry cites a Google-owned or Microsoft-owned URL; third-party-only claims go to unverified[]. Claims whose primary page was seen only as a search snippet also go to unverified[].
note: Ranking-update dates come from the Google Search Status Dashboard (fact:F-T-36). Documentation and policy entries come from Google Search Central, Google support pages, Chrome for Developers and the Bing blogs as read on 2026-11-01. An update that overlaps a traffic change is a hypothesis to test, not a cause.

updates.name: FAQ rich results limited to government and health sites; HowTo rich results desktop-only (both later removed)
updates.notes: HowTo was deprecated on all devices on 2023-09-14; FAQ display ended on 2026-05-07.

updates.name: HowTo rich results deprecated on all devices
March 2024 core update
updates.notes: Rollout about 45 days. Google's ranking systems guide says the helpful content system became part of the core ranking systems in March 2024 (fact:F-T-35).

updates.name: March 2024 spam update
Spam policies for expired domain abuse, scaled content abuse and site reputation abuse introduced
updates.notes: Site reputation abuse enforcement started on 2024-05-05.

updates.name: Site reputation abuse enforcement begins
June 2024 spam update
August 2024 core update
November 2024 core update
Site reputation abuse policy clarified: first-party involvement, white-label services, licensing or partial ownership do not make exploitative third-party content first-party
Sitelinks search box removed worldwide (announced 2024-10-21)
updates.notes: WebSite markup is still used for site names; leftover SearchAction markup causes no issues.

updates.name: December 2024 core update
December 2024 spam update
Review snippet guidance recommends accepting only reviews with a comment and an author name
updates.notes: Listed among the dated structured-data documentation changes in the 2026-11-01 research pass.

updates.name: Site reputation abuse policy: further clarification
Breadcrumb rich results documented as desktop only
March 2025 core update
Guidance to block auto-translated pages with robots.txt withdrawn
updates.notes: Changelog entry in the hreflang and localized-versions documentation.

updates.name: Search results simplification announced: Book Actions, Course Info, Claim Review, Estimated Salary, Learning Video, Special Announcement and Vehicle Listing
updates.notes: Google said the change would not affect how pages are ranked. Book actions were later kept (fact:F-T-05).

updates.name: AI Mode traffic counted in Search Console Performance totals (Web search type)
June 2025 core update
Special announcement deprecation took effect (notice 2025-04-23)
Bing: sitemaps in AI-powered search (lastmod is a key signal; changefreq and priority are ignored)
updates.notes: Bing recommends sitemaps together with IndexNow.

updates.name: August 2025 spam update
Six simplified features dropped from Search Console reports, the Rich Results Test and search-appearance filters; their documentation removed
updates.notes: Book actions were not part of this step. API support continued through December 2025; bulk export fields are NULL from 2025-10-01.

updates.name: Bing supports the data-nosnippet attribute (content stays indexed but is kept out of Bing snippets and Copilot answers)
Practice problem deprecation notice; Book actions deprecation banner removed; Dataset clarified as Dataset Search
updates.notes: Book actions stay documented for large book providers (fact:F-T-05); practice problems: fact:F-T-07.

updates.name: Loyalty program and member pricing (beta), Organization-level shipping policy, and review and aggregate rating nesting clarified
December 2025 core update
updates.notes: Rollout about 18 days.

updates.name: noindex on JavaScript pages clarified (Google may skip rendering for noindex pages)
Canonical best practices for JavaScript sites added
Practice problem documentation removed
Googlebot fetch limit documented as the first 2 MB (uncompressed) of a supported file type
updates.notes: Page date 2026-02-03; earlier documentation said 15 MB, which third parties report Google called a documentation error. PDFs: 64 MB.

updates.name: February 2026 Discover core update
Bing Webmaster Tools AI Performance report (public preview)
updates.notes: Citations, cited pages and sampled grounding queries across Copilot, Bing AI summaries and select partners; it reports no ranking, clicks or conversions.

updates.name: Google-Agent documented as a user-triggered agent (generally ignores robots.txt)
updates.notes: Web Bot Auth experiment with the identity https://agent.bot.goog.

updates.name: March 2026 spam update
Robots meta tags placed in the body are respected
updates.notes: Page updated 2026-03-24.

updates.name: DiscussionForumPosting and QAPage property additions
March 2026 core update
Back button hijacking added to the malicious practices spam policy (announced)
updates.notes: Site owners are responsible for code from third-party libraries and ad platforms.

updates.name: Spam reports may lead to manual actions
updates.notes: Changelog entries dated 2026-04-14 and 2026-04-23.

updates.name: Snippet documentation adds Read more deep links
updates.notes: More likely when content is visible, scroll position is not forced by JavaScript and the hash fragment is preserved.

updates.name: FAQ rich results no longer shown in Google Search (notice added 2026-05-08)
updates.notes: FAQPage stays valid schema.org vocabulary.

updates.name: Generative AI optimization guide published (no llms.txt, special files or special markup needed; misconceptions listed)
Spam policies: attempting to manipulate generative AI responses in Google Search counts as spam
Merchant listings add hasAdultConsideration
May 2026 core update
Preferred sources badge extended to AI Mode and AI Overviews
updates.notes: Domain or subdomain level; requires inclusion through the Search generative AI control.

updates.name: Search generative AI control in Search Console announced (UK subset first)
updates.notes: Include, Exclude or Inherit; covers AI Overviews, AI Mode and Discover generative AI features; it does not affect training.

updates.name: Search Console generative AI performance reports announced
updates.notes: Impressions by page, country, device and date; no API is mentioned.

updates.name: Back button hijacking enforcement begins
updates.notes: Manual actions or automated demotion.

updates.name: FAQ rich result documentation removed
AI optimization guide clarifies that Google Search ignores llms.txt (it neither helps nor hurts)
June 2026 spam update
Product category as text or CategoryCode, and sale-price effective dates
Review snippets: fake and undisclosed incentivized reviews ruled out
August 2026 spam update
Site reputation policy: manual actions have no effect for users in the EEA from 2026-08-30; policy renamed from site reputation abuse
updates.notes: Outside the EEA the affected section is still demoted; notices, reconsideration and mediation remain.

updates.name: Search generative AI control available worldwide
updates.notes: Changes take about 1 to 2 days to apply.

updates.name: Generative AI performance reports available worldwide
Aggregator units documented for local business queries
September 2026 spam update
updates.notes: Rollout 13 days 16 hours.

updates.name: VideoObject adds creator and interactionStatistic types
CrUX experimental soft-navigation LCP, INP and CLS for single-page apps (September 2026 release)
updates.notes: Available in BigQuery and the APIs; Chrome UX Report, not Google Search.

updates.name: Bing AI Performance adds Topics Portfolio (beta)
robots.txt documentation recommends percent-encoding in rule paths
Google plans to honor the shared __usage_ai-training token in early 2027, treated as a Google-Extended disallow when Google-Extended is not set explicitly
updates.notes: Google-Extended governs Gemini training and grounding only (fact:F-AI-06).

updates.name: Bing announces separate AI training and AI grounding preferences (robots.txt token, Bingbot meta tag and X-Robots-Tag)
updates.notes: Honored from 2027-02-01; see scheduled[] for the dated steps.

scheduled.name: Bing Webmaster Tools temporary grounding preference opens for sites using NoArchive or NoCache on that date
Google honors the shared __usage_ai-training robots.txt token (Google says early 2027)
Bing honors the new AI training and grounding preferences as it crawls
Bing stops reading NOARCHIVE and NOCACHE as training or grounding preferences
Bing Webmaster Tools temporary grounding preferences expire
